title: First Love Suicide Pact
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shinji, a high school student who sees no future, goes up to a rooftop to jump and meets his teacher, Shinanoya, who makes him a shocking proposal; the publisher pitches it as 'an exuberant tale of double suicide' (AniList; MangaUpdates). It runs three volumes and is tagged for an age gap, a student-teacher romance and attempted suicide. A reader review describes a serious story whose main theme is death, which 'does romanticize suicide a bit'.
life_message: It explores whether a connection between two despairing people can give a reason to live, without clear answers (to verify).
